Early theories of mass communication suggested that audiences were passive recipients of media messages and thus vulnerable to manipulation. Which of the following best describes current thinking?
Option A: Audiences are more vulnerable and passive than ever before.
Option B: Television viewing, in particular, creates increased activity in the right hemisphere of the brain.
Option C: Active receivers are not uniformly affected by mass communication messages.
Option D: Technology has led to increasingly passive recipients at the ends of message transmission systems.
